Experience at Buffet Hoang Yen Premier Saigon Centre
Dec 2023 • Solo

Particularly fresh and attractively prepared seafood such as: crabs, giant, freshwater prawns, oysters, octopus, snails... In addition, the space is luxurious and cozy. The staff are friendly, cheerful and ready to assist me at any time, making me feel like I'm having a meal with my family. Thank you for giving me a great service experience. I will definitely recommend my friends and family to come here

Nice Asian Buffet
Aug 2019 • Couples
The restaurant is clean with a nice assortment of Asian dishes. 

My favorite was the Malaysian snapper which was a little spicy. 

They are many seafood dishes as well as land based selections. 

I was sorry that several dishes combined pork which I don’t eat. 

There is a selection of fruits and pastries to wind up the meal. 

Price was reasonable for the location. Staff was not sufficient to promptly remove used plates from the table
